title: [spec-gap][R-05-111/114/115/116] DTN 9.8 bundle: eviction FIFO-only everywhere, C-flag absent, 0x04 pending/pull unimplemented, Rust DtnBuffer unwired
description: Spec 9.8 divergences (bundle): (1) Eviction order - spec: expired messages first, then least-remaining-TTL, then per-destination fairness, then FIFO; all routing stacks implement FIFO-oldest-only (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/dtn.rs:159-170, C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/dtn.c:64-86, python router.py:880-892); only the python app-layer /msg/store (spec 18.1.4, different section, tracked l1qw.31) implements the spec order with a 24h cap. (2) Handoff via announce App Data Type 0x04 pending-destinations + pull request on seeing own IID: Python encode/decode + sim only (announce/coords.py:26,221,241 + tests/sim/test_dtn_sim.py); Rust/C absent; pull unimplemented everywhere. (3) DTN custody C-flag (bit6 0x40) exists in no stack (S-flag implemented+tested via dtn_sflag_hbh.json); no sender-side option insertion anywhere. (4) Rust DtnBuffer implemented but unwired (no non-test caller of buffer_message); C router path wired (router.c:744-762); Python buffer not called from route-decision DROP path. (5) TTL defaults partial: Rust no 24h/7d constants (expiry caller-supplied); C full (dtn.h:31-49); Python 7d max only. Related tracked: b7z9.122 (custody send path /msg/custody S+C), l1qw.31. Suggested placement: spec-order eviction in each routing DTN store; wire Rust buffer into the route DROP path; 0x04 pending + pull in Rust/C; C-flag left to b7z9.122 custody work.
